newsitem.title: ITALY: Tanker blaze off Italian coast kills six.
newsitem.headline: Tanker blaze off Italian coast kills six.

text.p: Six people were killed and three injured on Wednesday in a fire on a new methane gas tanker undergoing sea trials off northwest Italy, rescue services said.
The fire broke out in the engine room of the SNAM Portovenere at about 0415 GMT some 15 miles south of the port of Genoa, they said.
The vessel, the largest of its type constructed in Italy, was being towed to Genoa after the fire was brought under control. The cause of the blaze was not known, a fire service spokesman said.
Coastguard officials said the tanker, which was empty prior to going into service, had 188 people on board, many of them technicians and engineers conducting tests.
The vessel, built by Italian shipyard Fincantieri, was due for delivery to SNAM, a unit of state energy group ENI.
